hazards.control: Stay clear of the coil path, the gooseneck, and flowback iron under flow.

name: Gooseneck (guide arch)
function: The arched roller guide on top of the injector that bends the coil from the reel over into the vertical run of the injector.

tabs.overview: Radius chosen against the coil size to limit bending strain; rollers support the pipe around the arch; a straightener or counter-bend is fitted on some units.
tabs.engineering: Radius in the 72 to 120 in. class for common coil sizes; rollers per pipe size.
tabs.safety: The coil over the arch is a line-of-fire hazard if it parts; no one under the arch while running.
tabs.evidence: Public coiled tubing pressure control guide (S24), API RP 16ST and API RP 5C7 scope (S23, S26), field practice (S9).
